title: Investments & savings
eodNote: Listed prices are end-of-day{{asOf}}. Unlisted schemes (crypto, FDs, off-list) use the current value you enter, else cost.
syncNote: Live prices appear once the daily market sync runs; unlisted schemes use the value you enter, else cost.
noInvAccountBodyPost: (or stocks/mutual-funds) account, then add stocks, mutual funds, SIPs, crypto, FDs and other schemes here.
noInvestments: No investments yet — add your first with the button above.
dividendsNote: Estimated from held quantities × declared dividends this financial year (Apr–Mar).
removeMsg: “{{label}}” will be removed from your portfolio.
stopSipMsg: No further instalments will be recorded. The holding stays.
sipNote: On each SIP date we record a transfer of {{amount}} from that account into {{account}} — it shows under Recurring & Planned Cashflow too.
newOrHold: Is this a new investment or one you already hold?
noFundAccount: No savings/bank account to fund from — add one first, or track it as existing.
overFunds: That's more than the balance in {{account}}. Reduce the amount or pick another account.
existingNote: No money leaves your accounts — this only records an investment you already own.
allocationEmpty: Add investments to see your allocation
noDividendData: No dividend data yet. Once the daily market sync fetches dividend history for your holdings, income by period will appear here.
dividendFootnote: Estimated from your current share counts × declared dividend history. Amber bars are upcoming (scheduled ex-dates).
projectionFootnote: A projection using your assumptions, not a forecast or advice. Growth is hypothetical; actual returns vary and can be negative.
noInstrumentMatches: No matches. Type a ticker or company name.
startTypingInstrument: Start typing a ticker or company name.
catalogSeedNote: This is our built-in list of widely held stocks and ETFs. Can't find yours? Choose “Not listed” and type its name.
errInstrument: Pick an instrument from the list.
errFundingAccount: Choose an account to fund this from.
errSipAmount: Enter the amount to invest each time.
errSipSource: Choose the account each instalment is debited from.
errNoUser: Couldn't work out who is signed in. Try again.
errAddFailed: Couldn't add the investment. Nothing was saved.
errHoldingNotFound: That investment is no longer here.
